newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT wins Opel parts distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: TNT wins Opel parts distribution deal.

text.p: TNT Worldwide Express said it has won a nine million mark contract from Opel/Vauxhall for European spare parts distribution.
The company will take over delivery by air and road of parts for the dealer and workshop after-sales market, a TNT statement said.
The contract covers transport of spare parts for all Opel and Vauxhall models from central warehouses in Germany, Britain and Spain, it added.

Ludo Van De Putte,European Logistics manager for General Motors international operations aftersales, said TNT won the contract as it had developed a tailor-made service for the automobile manufacturer.
"The company guarantees late collection in our central warehouses and cross-border delivery to our dealers by noon next day at the latest," he added.
TNT said it had adapted its Spanish road network to allow later collection times from Opel/Vauxhall locations.

Adam Shuter, TNT Express Worldwide general manager automotive division, said: "It is no longer sufficient to offer standard solutions for express distribution. Instead, we must be creative and diverse and offer out of the ordinary services." --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
